# AI Customer Support Chatbot

This is an AI-based customer support chatbot built using Python, Flask, Scikit-Learn, NLTK, and SpaCy.

## Features

- Greeting response
- Order tracking support
- Refund support
- Payment issue support
- Product information support
- Complaint handling
- Contact support response

## Technologies Used

- Python
- Flask
- Scikit-Learn
- NLTK
- SpaCy

## How to Run

Install required libraries:

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
